{"triples": [{"subject": "RNNs", "predicate": "uses", "object": "morphological compositionality", "object_type": "Concept", "source_sentence": "Our work does not simply concatenate vectors of morphemes, but rather combines them using RNNs, which captures morphological compositionality."}]}
